aka.zh: 乔治六世国王公路（素里段，1940 年）
温哥华—布莱恩高速公路
达菲湖路（彭伯顿至利卢埃特）

tagline.en: From the Peace Arch through Vancouver to the Cariboo, rebuilt along Howe Sound for the 2010 Olympics
tagline.zh: 自和平拱门穿过温哥华直抵卡里布高原；豪湾沿岸一段为 2010 年冬奥会而重建

start.en: The Peace Arch border crossing at Surrey, where Interstate 5 from Seattle becomes Highway 99
start.zh: 素里的和平拱门口岸，来自西雅图的 5 号州际公路在此变为 99 号公路

end.en: The junction with Highway 97 north of Cache Creek, in the dry Interior
end.zh: 卡什溪以北与 97 号公路的交会处，地处干燥的内陆高原

en: Highway 99 is three roads under one number. From the Peace Arch it is a four-lane freeway across the Fraser delta, under the river in the George Massey Tunnel and over it on the Oak Street Bridge. Through Vancouver it becomes city streets — Granville Street, the Granville Bridge, Georgia Street — then crosses Stanley Park and the Lions Gate Bridge to the North Shore.

Beyond Horseshoe Bay it is the Sea to Sky Highway, cut into the cliffs above Howe Sound with the railway below it, climbing past Squamish to Whistler and Pemberton. The last stretch, the Duffey Lake Road, crosses the Coast Mountains to Lillooet, tops out at Cayoosh Pass at about 1,275 metres, and comes down into the dry Interior to meet Highway 97 near Cache Creek.
The number was borrowed from the south. British Columbia chose 99 in 1940 to match US Route 99, the road it met at the border, and kept it after the American route became Interstate 5.
zh: 99 号公路是共用一个编号的三条路。自和平拱门起，它是一条四车道高速公路，横越菲沙河三角洲，经乔治·梅西隧道从河底穿过，再经橡树街大桥跨越河道。进入温哥华后，它变为城市街道——格兰维尔街、格兰维尔桥、乔治亚街——随后穿过史丹利公园、经狮门大桥抵达北岸。
过了马蹄湾，它就是“海天公路”：在豪湾上方的峭壁上开凿而成，铁路在其下方，一路爬升经斯阔米什到惠斯勒与彭伯顿。最后一段名为达菲湖路，翻越海岸山脉到利卢埃特，在海拔约 1,275 米的卡尤什山口达到最高点，再下到干燥的内陆，在卡什溪附近与 97 号公路相接。
这个编号来自南方。不列颠哥伦比亚省于 1940 年选定 99，以对应在边境与之相接的美国 99 号公路；美方路线后来改为 5 号州际公路，加方仍沿用此号。

en: The first piece was the King George VI Highway through Surrey, dedicated at the Peace Arch on 16 October 1940. The road north of Vancouver came later: the Upper Levels Highway to Horseshoe Bay opened in 1957, and the Seaview Highway along Howe Sound to Squamish on 7 August 1958, built beside the Pacific Great Eastern Railway, which had reached Squamish two years earlier.

The freeway south of the city opened in stages. The Deas Island Tunnel, now the George Massey Tunnel, opened in May 1959 and was dedicated by Queen Elizabeth II that July; the four-lane freeway from the tunnel to the border followed on 29 May 1962. Tolls on the tunnel and the Oak Street Bridge ended on 31 March 1964.

Northward, a road reached Alta Lake in time for the ski area on Whistler Mountain to open in January 1966, and the highway was paved to Pemberton and Mount Currie by the mid-1970s. The Duffey Lake Road, a logging road the province took over in 1979, was paved in 1990–91 and became part of Highway 99 in 1992.

For the 2010 Winter Olympics, held in Vancouver and Whistler, the province rebuilt the Horseshoe Bay–Whistler section between 2003 and 2009: four lanes to Lions Bay and through Squamish, three lanes from Squamish to Whistler, wider bridges and rockfall protection. About two-thirds of it was let as British Columbia's first design-build-finance-operate contract, a 25-year concession signed in June 2005. Protesters at Eagleridge Bluffs in West Vancouver, who wanted a tunnel instead, were removed under a court injunction.
zh: 最早的一段是穿过素里的乔治六世国王公路，于 1940 年 10 月 16 日在和平拱门举行落成仪式。温哥华以北的道路建得更晚：通往马蹄湾的上层公路于 1957 年通车；沿豪湾通往斯阔米什的“海景公路”于 1958 年 8 月 7 日通车，它紧邻太平洋大东方铁路修建，而该铁路两年前已通到斯阔米什。
城南的高速公路分段开通。迪斯岛隧道（今乔治·梅西隧道）于 1959 年 5 月通车，同年 7 月由伊丽莎白二世女王主持落成；自隧道至边境的四车道高速公路于 1962 年 5 月 29 日随之开通。隧道与橡树街大桥的收费于 1964 年 3 月 31 日取消。
向北，一条道路赶在惠斯勒山滑雪场 1966 年 1 月开业前修到了阿尔塔湖；到 20 世纪 70 年代中期，公路已铺装至彭伯顿与芒特柯里。达菲湖路原是一条伐木道路，1979 年由省政府接管，1990 至 1991 年铺装，1992 年并入 99 号公路。
为迎接在温哥华与惠斯勒举办的 2010 年冬奥会，该省在 2003 至 2009 年间重建了马蹄湾至惠斯勒路段：至莱恩斯湾及穿过斯阔米什的路段为四车道，斯阔米什至惠斯勒为三车道，桥梁加宽，并加装落石防护。其中约三分之二以不列颠哥伦比亚省首个“设计—建造—融资—运营”合同发包，即 2005 年 6 月签订的 25 年特许经营协议。西温哥华鹰岭崖的抗议者主张改建隧道，后依法院禁令被清离现场。

en: The Sea to Sky rebuild is usually quoted at $600 million, the figure the province gave on completion in 2009. Its 2008 service plan gave a larger number, a total authorised capital budget of $796 million; the two have not been reconciled in anything published, and the gap may be a matter of scope. Of the $600 million, about $400 million was the work of the concessionaire, S2S Transportation Group, which financed it and is repaid by the province over the 25-year term.

The next large bill is at the southern end. In 2021 the province chose an eight-lane immersed-tube tunnel to replace the George Massey Tunnel, estimated at $4.15 billion and due in 2030. In 2026 it raised the budget to $8.5 billion, with Ottawa contributing up to $3 billion, and moved completion to September 2031.
zh: 海天公路的重建通常被引为 6 亿加元，这是该省 2009 年竣工时公布的数字。该省 2008 年的服务计划给出的数字更大：批准的资本预算总额为 7.96 亿加元。两者在已公开的资料中从未对账，差额可能源于口径不同。在 6 亿加元中，约 4 亿加元的工程由特许经营方 S2S Transportation Group 承担；该公司自行融资，由省政府在 25 年期内分期偿付。
下一笔大账在南端。2021 年，该省选定以一条八车道沉管隧道取代乔治·梅西隧道，估价 41.5 亿加元，计划 2030 年完工。2026 年，预算上调至 85 亿加元，其中联邦政府出资最多 30 亿加元，完工时间推迟至 2031 年 9 月。

value.en: 365.7 km summed from the ministry's 2026 section inventory. English Wikipedia gives 377 km, citing the same inventory's 2016 edition; the Sea to Sky name covers the 134 km from Horseshoe Bay to Pemberton.
value.zh: 据该厅 2026 年分段清单累加为 365.7 公里。英文维基百科引同一清单 2016 年版，给出 377 公里；“海天公路”之名指马蹄湾至彭伯顿的 134 公里。

figures.source: British Columbia Ministry of Transportation and Transit, Landmark Kilometre Inventory, edition 202607 (computed); English Wikipedia, British Columbia Highway 99

value.en: No route-wide figure. Sections: King George VI Highway $800,000 (1940) and Seaview Highway to Squamish $11 million (1958), both as cited in English Wikipedia, British Columbia Highway 99, from contemporary newspapers; the freeway from the Oak Street Bridge to the border, including the tunnel, about $57 million (1962); paving the Duffey Lake Road $22.5 million (1990–91), as cited in English Wikipedia; Sea to Sky improvements $600 million (2003–09).
value.zh: 无全线数字。分段：乔治六世国王公路 80 万加元（1940 年）、至斯阔米什的海景公路 1,100 万加元（1958 年），均据英文维基百科“不列颠哥伦比亚 99 号公路”条目所引当时报纸；橡树街大桥至边境的高速公路（含隧道）约 5,700 万加元（1962 年）；达菲湖路铺装 2,250 万加元（1990—1991 年），据英文维基百科；海天公路改善工程 6 亿加元（2003—2009 年）。

figures.source: BC Ministry of Transportation, Frontier to Freeway (freeway cost); BC Government news release 2009TRAN0003, 15 January 2009 (Sea to Sky); English Wikipedia, British Columbia Highway 99 (other sections)

value.en: The province. The Sea to Sky concession was privately financed and is repaid by British Columbia over 25 years; the George Massey replacement is the first part of the road with a federal share, up to $3 billion.
value.zh: 省政府。海天公路特许项目由私人融资、不列颠哥伦比亚省在 25 年内偿付；乔治·梅西隧道的替代工程是该路首个有联邦出资的部分，最多 30 亿加元。

figures.source: Sea-to-Sky Highway Improvement Project Concession Agreement, 3 June 2005; BC Government news release 2026TT0066

label.en: Sea to Sky budget: two figures
label.zh: 海天公路预算：两个数字

value.en: $600 million “overall cost” (January 2009); $796 million “total authorized capital budget” (2008/09 service plan). Not reconciled in any published source found.
value.zh: 6 亿加元“总成本”（2009 年 1 月）；7.96 亿加元“批准的资本预算总额”（2008/09 年度服务计划）。在已找到的公开资料中未见对账。

figures.source: BC Government news release 2009TRAN0003; BC Ministry of Transportation, 2008/09–2010/11 Service Plan

label.zh: 乔治·梅西隧道替代工程

value.en: Eight-lane immersed-tube tunnel, toll-free. $4.15 billion and 2030 when chosen in 2021; $8.5 billion and September 2031 in the 2026 update.
value.zh: 八车道沉管隧道，不收费。2021 年选定时为 41.5 亿加元、2030 年完工；2026 年更新为 85 亿加元、2031 年 9 月完工。

timeline.en: The King George VI Highway through Surrey is dedicated at the Peace Arch on 16 October and numbered 99 to match US Route 99.
timeline.zh: 10 月 16 日，穿过素里的乔治六世国王公路在和平拱门落成，编为 99 号以对应美国 99 号公路。

timeline.en: The Seaview Highway from Horseshoe Bay to Squamish opens on 7 August.
timeline.zh: 8 月 7 日，马蹄湾至斯阔米什的海景公路通车。

timeline.en: The Deas Island Tunnel under the Fraser opens in May and is dedicated by Queen Elizabeth II in July.
timeline.zh: 菲沙河底的迪斯岛隧道于 5 月通车，7 月由伊丽莎白二世女王主持落成。

timeline.en: The four-lane freeway from the tunnel to the US border opens on 29 May.
timeline.zh: 5 月 29 日，自隧道至美国边境的四车道高速公路通车。

timeline.en: The road to Alta Lake is open for the start of skiing on Whistler Mountain in January.
timeline.zh: 1 月，惠斯勒山滑雪场开业时，通往阿尔塔湖的道路已经开通。

timeline.en: The paved Duffey Lake Road becomes part of Highway 99, extending it to Lillooet and the Interior.
timeline.zh: 铺装后的达菲湖路并入 99 号公路，使其延伸至利卢埃特与内陆。

timeline.en: The province signs a 25-year design-build-finance-operate concession for the Sea to Sky improvements in June.
timeline.zh: 6 月，该省就海天公路改善工程签署 25 年期“设计—建造—融资—运营”特许协议。

timeline.en: The $600 million Sea to Sky Highway Improvement Project is completed in October, four months before the Olympics.
timeline.zh: 10 月，耗资 6 亿加元的海天公路改善工程竣工，距冬奥会开幕四个月。

timeline.en: The province chooses an eight-lane immersed-tube tunnel to replace the George Massey Tunnel.
timeline.zh: 该省选定以八车道沉管隧道取代乔治·梅西隧道。

timeline.en: Early works on the replacement tunnel begin in January; the budget is revised to $8.5 billion, with up to $3 billion from Ottawa.
timeline.zh: 1 月，替代隧道前期工程开工；预算修订为 85 亿加元，其中联邦出资最多 30 亿加元。
